records.key: Pan; other tools also accept Shift + drag
records.source: Pan; other tools also accept Shift + drag
records.translation: Færa sýn; önnur verkfæri leyfa líka Shift + draga

records.key: Keep painting the last object across a gap
records.source: Keep painting the last object across a gap
records.translation: Halda áfram að mála síðasta hlut yfir bil

records.key: Each separate stroke paints a new object; a stroke that starts on or touches an object extends it. Hold Shift to keep painting the last object across a gap.
records.source: Each separate stroke paints a new object; a stroke that starts on or touches an object extends it. Hold Shift to keep painting the last object across a gap.
records.translation: Hvert aðskilið burstastrok málar nýjan hlut; strok sem byrjar á hlut eða snertir hann stækkar hann. Haltu Shift niðri til að halda áfram að mála síðasta hlut yfir bil.

records.key: How far one wheel notch zooms. Higher jumps across a large field faster; lower gives the fine steps that trimming an object boundary needs. Alt + drag pans with every tool; Shift + drag also pans with tools other than the Brush.
records.source: How far one wheel notch zooms. Higher jumps across a large field faster; lower gives the fine steps that trimming an object boundary needs. Alt + drag pans with every tool; Shift + drag also pans with tools other than the Brush.
records.translation: Hversu mikið eitt skref músarhjólsins þysjar. Hærra gildi færir þig hraðar um stórt myndsvið; lægra gefur fínu skrefin sem þarf til að snyrta jaðar hlutar. Alt + draga færir sýnina með öllum verkfærum; Shift + draga færir hana líka með öðrum verkfærum en Bursta.

records.key: The Wand is still filling the last click.
records.source: The Wand is still filling the last click.
records.translation: Sprotinn er enn að fylla svæðið frá síðasta smelli.

records.key: The Wand could not fill that region: {error}
records.source: The Wand could not fill that region: {error}
records.translation: Sprotinn gat ekki fyllt þetta svæði: {error}

records.key: The Wand region was not applied: the mask changed while it was being filled.
records.source: The Wand region was not applied: the mask changed while it was being filled.
records.translation: Svæði sprotans var ekki notað: maskinn breyttist á meðan svæðið var fyllt.
